Fixtures for scripts/fetch_fert_ams.py --selftest.

ams_3195_real_2026-10-02.txt is a REAL capture: the pdftotext output of
ams_3195.pdf (report dated Fri Oct 2, 2026) that the fertilizer-ams workflow
saved with probe ticked on 2026-10-15 (run 38692414508, data/fert-ams-raw/).
It is copied here unchanged and is the main selftest case.

ams_3195_mmn_layout.txt and ams_3195_flat.txt are RECONSTRUCTIONS written
before the real file had been read, from public search snippets. EVERY PRICE
IN THOSE TWO FILES IS MADE UP for the test. None of them is a USDA figure and
none may ever be copied onto the site. They stay as a row-per-line layout.
